## What lands

- **`/sources/<id>/` (T1, zero-JS):** the source page, part A (K10 §5–8) — header (lifecycle chip, status flags, "runs since this release" status-lane link), the at-a-glance K9 field set, the about block, scrubbed ground-truth links (S-1/S-6 forms from the emitted row) with terms capture where an ADR-183 record exists, the targets table (typed absence until the targets artifact ships), licence + SIG's publication basis + the N-4 correction notice, the rights-review record with its coverage-class disclosures, observed collection conduct (robots outcomes per host — all executions + latest, refusal classes, rate-limit/quota/budget events), and cadence/freshness (declared vs observed, freshness verdict + staleness, the FIG-01b `strip` runs-over-time figure with its table equivalent).
- **Honesty throughout:** every field a value or a named absence (SIG-TRANSP-003); a data-bearing source with no executions feed renders the `run_record_missing` honesty (SIG-TRANSP-037); gated/refused/withdrawn + unknown/restricted-lane sources render the S-11 registry-only page — never a run, capture or probe detail (D-J3-11).
- **The seams:** `web/src/lib/source-page.ts` composes `transparency/sources.json` rows + per-source `executions.jsonl` (export mode fails loud on malformed bytes, honest absence on a missing feed) + `freshness.jsonl` + `terms_disclosure.json`; `transparency/sources/<id>/{executions,captures,targets,issues}.jsonl` joins the figure-artifact patterns (byte-pinned in `figures.ts`/`check-figures.mjs`); `/sources/*/` claims its own page-registry row under `sig.source-page/2`; the runs strip composes `sig.figure-kit-chart/1` and renders through the kit CLI (`npm run fixture:source-figures` — the same seam `emit-entity-figures` uses), inlined only after the safety contract re-verifies.
- **Out of scope (P36.69):** the runs/captures/versions/entities/dossiers sub-routes, the JSON twin, the sources table (P36.48).
